title: Artificial intelligence-assisted optimization of Lentinula edodes extracts for enhanced bioactive profile and therapeutic potential.
summary: Optimized edible-mushroom extracts outperform the stated RSM comparator in reported assays; this establishes extract properties, not therapeutic efficacy. Journal publication and later record dates differ.
ai_technology: Artificial neural network with genetic-algorithm optimization
organization: Osmaniye Korkut Ata University; S.Seifullin Kazakh Agro Technical University; Ankara University

evidence.tested: Optimized edible-mushroom extracts outperform the stated RSM comparator in reported assays; this establishes extract properties, not therapeutic efficacy. Journal publication and later record dates differ.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Artificial neural network with genetic-algorithm optimization is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
